{"entry":"adopt","command":"/adopt","problem":"Claude Code Game Studios is one project template (867 files: 78 skills that call its own scripts, docs and hooks), so a per-skill Gene would break 75 of them and the whole template exceeds the 256-file skill limit. Every Gene here pins one 2-file installer skill that fetches the template at a pinned commit, checks its git tree id and only adds missing files; entry Genes differ in what they are recalled for and which studio command they hand over to.","argument_hint":"[focus: full | gdds | adrs | stories | infra]","description":"Brownfield audit — do existing artifacts actually work? Numbered migration plan. Unlike /project-stage-detect, checks compliance not existence.","user_only":false,"sections":["Phase 1: Detect Project State","Phase 2: Format Audit","Phase 3: Classify and Prioritise Gaps","Phase 4: Build the Migration Plan","Phase 5: Present Summary and Ask to Write","Phase 6: Write the Adoption Plan","Phase 7: Offer First Action","Collaborative Protocol"],"handover":"5. Hand over the command that matches the request, to run in the new session:
   - make or change a game: `/prototype <idea>`
   - new user, no idea or engine yet: `/start`
   - wants game ideas: `/brainstorm <genre or open>`
   - existing project to bring in: `/prototype --from <path>` for a browser game, `/adopt` for
     design docs and stories
   - launch readiness: `/launch-checklist` (it starts only when the user types it)

strategy: 先按前置条件安装 skill ccgs-studio-setup 并通读；项目根目录已有 project.yaml 和 .zcode/skills/adopt/ 时说明已装过，跳过安装。
运行 sh .agents/skills/ccgs-studio-setup/install.sh <folder>：新游戏用新的空目录，已有项目用它的根目录；脚本按固定 commit 取模板、核对 tree id、只补缺失文件，不覆盖任何已有文件，被保留的文件逐个告诉用户。
请用户以该目录为根重开 ZCode：工作室的 agent、skill 和 hooks 只在会话开始时加载，本会话里还不存在。
在新会话里：已有网页游戏用 /prototype --from <路径> 原样接入，设计文档和故事用 /adopt 审计并给出迁移计划。
summary: CCGS 入口 /adopt：先用 ccgs-studio-setup 把 Claude Code Game Studios（ZCode 版 v1.3.0，MIT）整套装进项目，重开 ZCode 后运行 /adopt；正文记下该命令的说明、参数和章节目录、钉住的安装 skill 与模板 commit。（此 Gene 在前置条件中钉住 skill ccgs-studio-setup，使用前先安装并阅读它。）
code_snippet:
test -f project.yaml && test -d .zcode/skills/adopt || sh .agents/skills/ccgs-studio-setup/install.sh .
test -f .zcode/hooks/yaml-helper.sh && echo installed
# restart ZCode with this folder as the root, then in the new session:
/adopt [focus: full | gdds | adrs | stories | infra]
